summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 12, 2026, announcing that its 51%-owned subsidiary Charging Robotics Ltd. launched a next-generation automated EV-charging platform for robotaxis, autonomous fleets and automated parking. The system uses resonant inductive power transfer, targets up to 10 kW and up to 95% efficiency, and includes AI-driven scheduling and remote monitoring. No transaction, stake change, price, premium, advisory or board recommendation is stated. The filing is a routine operational product announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
